description: This Java class defines enumeration mappings for interest rate chart period types, converting internal enum values into externally usable data objects (EnumOptionData). It provides methods to retrieve enumeration options based on integer input, enum type, or array of enum types.

classes.name: InterestRateChartEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to map PeriodFrequencyType enums to EnumOptionData objects for use in interest rate chart configurations.

methods.name: periodType(Integer type)
methods.description: Converts an integer to a PeriodFrequencyType and returns its corresponding EnumOptionData representation.

methods.name: periodType(PeriodFrequencyType type)
methods.description: Maps a specific PeriodFrequencyType enum value to an EnumOptionData object representing the period type.

methods.name: periodType(PeriodFrequencyType[] periodTypes)
methods.description: Transforms an array of PeriodFrequencyType enums into a list of EnumOptionData objects, excluding invalid types.
